title: Group and longitudinal intra-individual networks of eating disorder symptoms in adolescents and young adults at-risk for an eating disorder
sample_size: 1272 participants for group-level networks; 50 participants for individual networks
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-person network
limitations: - Small sample size for individual networks (n=50); - Retrospective data collection may introduce recall bias; - Time lag of four weeks may not capture rapid symptom dynamics; - Cannot establish causality due to non-experimental design; - Network models may be less robust with low symptom endorsement; - Future research needed to test in non-treatment-seeking samples.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether the study was preregistered. However, the authors mention that they used a random selection of 50 individuals for individual network analysis, which suggests a methodological decision made after data collection. Code and data availability are declared in the paper, but no specific repository or link is provided.
